emma (docs): Heads-up: I'm opening a tiny docs PR to clarify how 'usage tiers' map to billing windows, add a short migration note for renamed Grafana panels, and include a minimal JS SDK snippet for header fallback. Draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1422

ryan (billing): Please add one line about prorating when tiers change mid-window. Example sentence is fine: 'Charges are prorated for time spent in each tier within the billing window.'

kate (analytics): Also include the dashboard-derived field name effective_tier and the new panel id grafana/usage/tiers-2026 so saved links don't break. We rely on that field in alerts.

marc (platform): Note: new Dedicated nodes emit X-RW-Rate and X-RW-Burst; Hosted still uses X-Rate-Limit and X-Burst-Credits. Docs should show both and recommend fallback parsing.

nina (sdk): I'll paste a tiny JS fetch snippet customers can copy-paste to read headers with back-compat. Keep it one block so it's quick to use.

emma (docs): Draft migration blurb: "If your Grafana links 404 after the panel rename, search dashboards for grafana/usage/tiers-2026 and replace legacy panel ids. Saved alerts bound to old panels will need to be reattached to the new panel." Short + actionable.

nina (sdk): JS snippet (fetch):

```js
// prefer new -> legacy header fallback
const limit = res.headers.get('X-RW-Rate') || res.headers.get('X-Rate-Limit');
const burst = res.headers.get('X-RW-Burst') || res.headers.get('X-Burst-Credits') || '0';
console.log(`rate=${limit}, burstCredits=${burst}`);
```

kate (analytics): LGTM. Add a parenthetical: '(burstCredits is an accumulated counter; not an instantaneous QPS)'. We'll add a dashboard tooltip too.

ryan (billing): Also include a one-line example of prorate math (non-exact): 'e.g., if you spend 4 hours in Tier B and the rest in Tier A within the billing window, the charge for Tier B is prorated to those 4 hours.' Keeps expectations clear.

marc (platform): Small ask: add a compatibility table in docs: legacy header -> new header, legacy panel id -> grafana/usage/tiers-2026, affected deployment (Hosted/Dedicated). One-row table is enough.

emma (docs): Will add the tiny table + the snippets + the migration blurb. Opening PR now. CI should run. Tagging @kate @nina for quick thumbs on content. Thanks! :sparkles:

ci-bot: PR opened by emma (docs) — lint OK, linkcheck queued.

emma (docs): Targeting merge after linkcheck passes, ETA tomorrow AM PST. Ping if you need edits before then.
